documentationFacts.fact: Saved configuration is local browser persistence; this does not prevent external computation/service requests. Remove unsupported blanket no tracking/no server-stored information wording without asserting a provider retention policy.

documentationFacts.section: README / privacy table / Approximate area detection
documentationFacts.fact: Builder initialization; widget coarse-detection paths including local/preferLocal resolution and Reset re-detection when required by the current resolver. Recipient: https://get.geojs.io/v1/ip/geo.json; on failure https://ipinfo.io/json. Sent fields: Connection IP accompanies the request; these URL strings have no typed query or location coordinate parameters. IANA timezone detection uses local Intl. Limitations: Coarse IP-derived location is approximate; this is not precise permission/GPS or a provider-retention claim.

Builder one-second debounce or Enter; widget Settings search on Enter; trimmed queries shorter than2 return no request. Recipient: Nominatim https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search. Sent fields: q contains the trimmed typed query; format=jsonv2, addressdetails=1, limit=5; countrycodes is the known home country only when the query contains a digit. Limitations: Alphabetic London has no digit-country bias. All requests also disclose connection IP; source construction/control proof does not claim a new external transmission.

documentationFacts.section: README / privacy table / Canadian-style prefix assist
documentationFacts.fact: Whitespace removed from typed query; leading letter-digit-letter pattern, in addition to Nominatim. Recipient: Zippopotam https://api.zippopotam.us/ca/<FSA>. Sent fields: First3 matched characters uppercased in the path, e.g. M5V2T6 -> /ca/M5V; no complete postcode or widget coordinate parameter is appended to that URL. Limitations: This tests a prefix, not validity of a complete Canadian postcode; malformed longer queries with that leading pattern still trigger it.

documentationFacts.section: README / privacy table / Builder coordinate reverse lookup
documentationFacts.fact: Eligible builder coordinate edits (700ms debounce) or permission-granted builder GPS; stale edit rejected, missing/non-numeric coordinate rejected, both automatic label/method controls off -> no request. Recipient: BigDataCloud https://api.bigdatacloud.net/data/reverse-geocode-client. Sent fields: latitude, longitude and localityLanguage=en; controlled example51.5/-0.12. Limitations: This is the builder caller. The in-widget precise-location path does not invoke builder reverse geocoding. Actual browser/host permission is needed for GPS.

documentationFacts.section: README / privacy table / Prayer and current/hourly weather
documentationFacts.fact: Active eligible prayer request and current/hourly weather request; actual config/cache/simulation/currentness guards determine whether requests occur. Recipient: Aladhan https://api.aladhan.com/v1/timings/<date>; Open-Meteo https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast. Sent fields: Aladhan: latitude,longitude,method,school and requested date in path. Open-Meteo: latitude,longitude,timezone,temperature_unit(celsius/fahrenheit),wind_speed_unit=ms,current/hourly field selections and forecast_days=3. Limitations: List the actual weather-field selections below, not a generic local-only claim. Construction proof is not provider retention/availability or observed precipitation proof.

documentationFacts.section: README / privacy table / Radar evidence requests
documentationFacts.fact: Eligible active radar manifest then returned latest-past tile/frame under the existing weather currentness/cache guards. Recipient: RainViewer https://api.rainviewer.com/public/weather-maps.json and returned tile host/frame path. Sent fields: Returned host + frame.path + /256/<z>/<x>/<y>/2/1_1.png; x/y indices are derived from coordinates. Manifest URL has no coordinate query, tile indices still reveal a location-derived area. Limitations: No conclusion about millimetres, direct precipitation observation, availability or provider retention is added.

Page stylesheet/font loading subject to browser cache/network policy. Recipient: Google Fonts stylesheet fonts.googleapis.com and font resource host fonts.gstatic.com. Sent fields: Family/style/weight stylesheet request and returned font-resource URLs; no widget location/search fields in those source URLs; connection IP still accompanies external requests. Limitations: Preconnect/resource declarations are source proof; cache-dependent fetching is not a claim every load transmits every font.

documentationFacts.section: README / privacy table / separate Aladhan prayer row
documentationFacts.fact: Actual date-specific timings request to api.aladhan.com with latitude,longitude,method,school/date; connection IP is inherent. Keep this distinct from weather when rendering the eight-group table.

documentationFacts.section: README / privacy table / Open-Meteo weather fields
documentationFacts.fact: Actual current fields: temperature_2m,apparent_temperature,relative_humidity_2m,dew_point_2m,wind_speed_10m,wind_direction_10m,wind_gusts_10m,cloud_cover,cloud_cover_low,cloud_cover_mid,cloud_cover_high,visibility,is_day,weather_code,precipitation,rain,showers,snowfall. Actual hourly fields: temperature_2m,apparent_temperature,relative_humidity_2m,dew_point_2m,cloud_cover,cloud_cover_low,cloud_cover_mid,cloud_cover_high,wind_speed_10m,wind_direction_10m,wind_gusts_10m,precipitation,weather_code,visibility,is_day. URL also has coordinates,time zone,forecast_days=3,temperature_unit and wind_speed_unit=ms; cached/simulated/expired/currentness guards determine actual acquisition.
Reset removes only saved configuration KEY through clearLocal; retains unrelated prayer/weather caches, may re-detect area, and does not erase provider-held information or establish retention.
